_README: Per-NPC schedule records. `archetype` names a file in data/schedules/archetypes/. Station `pos` is WORLD coordinates - the cell origin plus the position the level script actually spawns them at, measured by booting the scene rather than read off the source. `interior: true` means the room behind that door is not modelled, so the NPC is absent from the world while the schedule has them there. A missing station key falls back to the authored spawn and warns loudly; it is never quietly relocated. Generated by _gen_schedules.py from a headless census; hand edits here are fine and will not be regenerated away without someone choosing to.
